{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float (already done in prior step, but reconfirm)
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('$', '', regex=False)
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
conversion_rates['conversion_rate'] = conversion_rates['sum'] / conversion_rates['count']
conversion_rates_sorted = conversion_rates.sort_values(by='conversion_rate', ascending=False)

# Check for confounding: cross-tabulate customer_segment with other variables
# Channel
channel_by_segment = pd.crosstab(sales_df['customer_segment'], sales_df['channel'])
# Status
status_by_segment = pd.crosstab(sales_df['customer_segment'], sales_df['status'])
# Age
age_by_segment = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['customer_age'].mean()

# Print cross-tabulations and summary stats
channel_by_segment, status_by_segment, age_by_segment"}
